$comment: The complete trusted-issuers.yml v1 format contract. See ARCHITECTURE.md sections 3.2 and 3.9. Runtime assembly checks public key contents and duplicate public keys, including different paths to the same key.
title: Chorus issuer trust directory v1

trusted-issuers.description: Local receiver approvals indexed by issuer node ID. An empty mapping grants no trust; tickets must target the local node.

enabled.description: When absent the issuer is enabled. False disables all of this issuer's keys.

key.description: Shorthand for a one-element keys list. Ed25519 X.509 SPKI public key path, relative to this trust file. Only used when keys is absent.

keys.description: Approved public key paths. Takes precedence over key when both are present.

items.description: Ed25519 X.509 SPKI public key path, relative to this trust file. Every listed key is approved while the issuer is enabled.
